observations: Photo 0 shows a close-up of an engine with pulleys, belts, and metal components. The engine appears used, with visible grime and wear.
Photo 1 shows the front of the engine with intake manifold, throttle body, and various hoses. The engine is dirty and appears to be in a workshop or storage area.
Photo 2 shows the side of the engine with the cylinder head, valve cover, and part of the intake manifold. The engine block is metallic and shows signs of use.
No brand or model is visible on any part of the engine in any photo.
The seller claims to deal in 'Japanese parts engine and accessories', but no Japanese branding or model is visible in the photos.
The watermark 'GOD OF ABRAHAM INVESTMENT' is present on all photos, suggesting the seller's name or business, not the item's origin.
